example: The bridge was closed, so we looked elsewhere for a way across the river.
example_translation: 桥封闭了，所以我们到别处寻找渡河的方法。
note: 副词；不加 to elsewhere

example: A narrow path began to emerge as the fog lifted.
example_translation: 雾散后，一条窄路开始显露出来。
note: 不及物；本例为逐渐显现

example: The team kept a spare radio for use in an emergency.
example_translation: 团队留了一部备用无线电，以便在紧急情况下使用。
note: in an emergency；可数名词

example: The letter expressed an emotion that she found hard to describe.
example_translation: 这封信表达了一种她难以形容的情感。
note: 可数的一种情感

example: A good listener shows empathy when a friend is upset.
example_translation: 朋友难过时，善于倾听的人会表现出同理心。
note: 不可数；理解他人的感受

example: The course places emphasis on using words in meaningful situations.
example_translation: 这门课程重视在有意义的情境中使用词语。
note: place emphasis on sth

example: The museum plans to employ two new guides next summer.
example_translation: 博物馆计划明年夏天雇用两位新向导。
note: employ sb；本例不是使用方法义

example: The room was empty except for a table and two chairs.
example_translation: 房间里除了一张桌子和两把椅子，空无一物。
note: 形容词；不是倒空动词

example: The new bridge will enable villagers to reach the market more easily.
example_translation: 新桥将使村民能够更方便地到达市场。
note: enable sb to do sth

example: We may encounter fallen trees on the path after the storm.
example_translation: 暴风雨后，我们可能会在小路上遇到倒下的树木。
note: 及物动词；encounter sth

example: The guide tried to encourage the tired walkers to keep going.
example_translation: 向导试着鼓励疲惫的步行者继续前进。
note: encourage sb to do sth

example: The bridge marks the end of this part of the trail.
example_translation: 这座桥标志着这一段小径的终点。
note: the end of sth；名词

example: In the story, the traveller helps a former enemy escape from danger.
example_translation: 故事中，旅人帮助一位昔日的敌人脱离危险。
note: 可数人物名词；不是特定现实群体

example: The energetic children offered to carry the light bags.
example_translation: 精力充沛的孩子们主动提出搬那些轻袋子。
note: 形容词；描述精力充沛

example: She still had enough energy to write in her diary after the long walk.
example_translation: 长途步行后，她仍有足够的精力写日记。
note: 本例不可数；不是物理能量或能源义

example: The students will engage in a discussion about the journey.
example_translation: 学生们将参与一次关于这段旅程的讨论。
note: engage in sth；本例为不及物用法

example: The mechanic checked the engine before the bus left.
example_translation: 公交车出发前，机械师检查了发动机。
note: 可数机器名词

example: An engineer inspected the old bridge before it reopened.
example_translation: 旧桥重新开放前，一位工程师对其进行了检查。
note: 可数职业名词；不是策划动词

example: English is the language used in this course.
example_translation: 这门课程使用的语言是英语。
note: 语言名称通常大写；本例为名词

example: Clear examples can enhance a learner's understanding of a word.
example_translation: 清晰的例句可以增进学习者对单词的理解。
note: enhance sth；及物动词

example: We enjoy walking along the river when the weather is cool.
example_translation: 天气凉爽时，我们喜欢沿河散步。
note: enjoy doing sth；不用 enjoy to do

example: An enormous fallen tree blocked the narrow road.
example_translation: 一棵倒下的巨树堵住了狭窄的道路。
note: 形容词；表示体积或程度很大

example: We have enough water for the rest of the walk.
example_translation: 我们有足够的水完成剩下的步行路程。
note: 本例为限定词，直接修饰名词 water

example: Check the list to ensure that every traveller has a map.
example_translation: 核对名单，确保每位旅人都有一张地图。
note: ensure that...；本例不涉及保险义

example: Please enter the hall through the door on the left.
example_translation: 请从左边的门进入大厅。
note: enter a place；不再加 into

example: The village supported a small enterprise that repaired bicycles.
example_translation: 村庄支持了一家修理自行车的小企业。
note: 可数企业义；不是进取精神

example: The village hall provides entertainment on winter evenings.
example_translation: 村里的礼堂在冬季夜晚提供娱乐活动。
note: 不可数活动名词

example: The volunteers were enthusiastic about improving the old trail.
example_translation: 志愿者们对改善这条旧小径热情高涨。
note: enthusiastic about sth/doing sth

example: The room looked entirely different after the repairs.
example_translation: 修缮后，房间看起来完全不同了。
note: 副词；修饰 different

example: This pass may entitle you to a discount at the museum.
example_translation: 这张通行证可能让你有权享受博物馆的折扣。
note: entitle sb to sth；本批不是给作品命名义

example: A lantern hung beside the entrance to the old hall.
example_translation: 旧礼堂的入口旁挂着一盏灯笼。
note: 名词读音；与使入迷的动词 entrance 区分

example: Entry to the museum is free on Sundays.
example_translation: 周日可以免费进入这座博物馆参观。
note: 本例为入场义；不是日记条目

example: She placed the folded letter inside a plain envelope.
example_translation: 她把折好的信放进一个素色信封。
note: 可数容器名词

example: The project aims to protect the environment around the lake.
example_translation: 这个项目旨在保护湖泊周围的环境。
note: 本例指自然环境

example: I sometimes envy her ability to stay calm under pressure.
example_translation: 我有时羡慕她在压力下保持冷静的能力。
note: envy sb/sth；本例为动词

example: We watched the first episode of the series before discussing its characters.
example_translation: 我们看完这部剧的第一集后讨论了其中的人物。
note: 可数的一集；不是疾病发作义

example: The two groups received equal amounts of time to prepare.
example_translation: 两组获得了相同的准备时间。
note: 形容词；不是等于的动词

example: The map shows the equator as a line around the middle of the earth.
example_translation: 地图把赤道画成环绕地球中部的一条线。
note: 通常使用 the equator

example: The team checked its equipment before leaving the campsite.
example_translation: 团队在离开营地前检查了装备。
note: 不可数；不用 an equipment

example: The railway opened a new era in the town's history.
example_translation: 这条铁路开启了小镇历史上的一个新时代。
note: a new era；可数名词

example: Use an eraser to remove the pencil mark from the map.
example_translation: 用橡皮擦去掉地图上的铅笔痕迹。
note: 可数文具名词；英式也常用 rubber

example: A small error in the address sent the parcel to another village.
example_translation: 地址中的一个小错误让包裹被送到了另一个村庄。
note: an error in sth

example: The volcano began to erupt after several days of small tremors.
example_translation: 经历几天轻微震动后，火山开始喷发。
note: 不及物；本例为火山喷发

example: The rabbit managed to escape through a gap in the fence.
example_translation: 兔子设法从栅栏的缺口逃走了。
note: 不及物；escape through/from

example: The trail is beautiful, especially when the autumn leaves change colour.
example_translation: 这条小径很美，尤其是在秋叶变色时。
note: 副词；不是 specially 专门地

example: She wrote an essay about how the river shaped the town.
example_translation: 她写了一篇关于河流如何影响小镇的文章。
note: an essay about/on sth

example: A reliable map is essential for this journey.
example_translation: 一张可靠的地图对这次旅行必不可少。
note: essential for sth

example: The volunteers hope to establish a small reading room in the village.
example_translation: 志愿者们希望在村里设立一间小阅览室。
note: establish sth；本例不是查明事实义

example: The walking route crosses an old estate near the river.
example_translation: 这条步行路线穿过河边的一座旧庄园。
note: 可数土地与建筑的整体；不是全部遗产义

example: We can estimate the distance by using the scale on the map.
example_translation: 我们可以利用地图上的比例尺估计距离。
note: 动词末尾读 /meɪt/；名词末尾不同

example: The class discussed the ethical questions raised by the new technology.
example_translation: 班上讨论了新技术带来的伦理问题。
note: 形容词；本例为涉及伦理的

example: The festival celebrates the region's ethnic diversity through music.
example_translation: 这个节日通过音乐展示了该地区的民族多样性。
note: ethnic diversity；不要简单等同于国籍

example: The exhibition compares transport systems in Europe and Asia.
example_translation: 展览比较了欧洲和亚洲的交通系统。
note: 专有名词通常大写；前面一般不加 the

example: The teacher will evaluate each project using the same criteria.
example_translation: 老师将使用相同的标准评估每个项目。
note: evaluate sth

example: On the eve of the journey, we checked our bags one last time.
example_translation: 旅程前夕，我们最后检查了一遍行李。
note: on the eve of sth

example: The path was so clear that even a first-time visitor could follow it.
example_translation: 小路如此清晰，连初次到访的人也能沿着它走。
note: 本例为副词；不是平坦或偶数义

example: We reached the village in the evening, just as the lamps came on.
example_translation: 我们在傍晚到达村庄，恰好赶上灯亮起来。
note: in the evening；时间名词

example: The school organized an event to welcome the visiting students.
example_translation: 学校组织了一场活动，欢迎来访的学生。
note: 本例为有组织的活动

example: After trying several paths, we eventually found the old bridge.
example_translation: 尝试了几条路后，我们终于找到了那座旧桥。
note: 表示经过一段时间后的结果

example: Have you ever visited a village without roads?
example_translation: 你曾经去过没有道路的村庄吗？
note: 疑问句中常见；不是 every

example: Every traveller received a copy of the route before leaving.
example_translation: 出发前，每位旅人都拿到了一份路线图。
note: 限定词；后接单数可数名词

example: The lesson shows how to use these words in everyday conversations.
example_translation: 这节课展示了如何在日常交谈中使用这些单词。
note: everyday 为形容词；与 every day 每天区分

example: Everything was ready before the travellers arrived.
example_translation: 旅人们到来之前，一切都准备好了。
note: 不定代词；本例谓语用单数 was

example: After the storm, fallen leaves lay everywhere.
example_translation: 暴风雨后，到处都是落叶。
note: 副词；不作名词使用

example: The footprints provided evidence that someone had used the path recently.
example_translation: 脚印证明最近有人走过这条小路。
note: 不可数；不用 an evidence

example: A simple idea can evolve into a useful tool through repeated testing.
example_translation: 一个简单的想法可以经过反复测试，逐渐发展成实用工具。
note: evolve into sth

example: The two lines are exactly the same length.
example_translation: 这两条线的长度恰好相同。
note: 副词；修饰 the same

example: The guide will examine the bridge before allowing anyone to cross.
example_translation: 向导会在允许任何人过桥前检查桥梁。
note: examine sth；本例不是正式考试义

example: The teacher gave one example before asking us to try the task.
example_translation: 老师在让我们尝试这项任务前举了一个例子。
note: give an example

example: The weight of the bags must not exceed the limit on the sign.
example_translation: 行李重量不得超过标牌上的限额。
note: exceed sth；不要再加 over

example: The village library has an excellent collection of local maps.
example_translation: 村里的图书馆收藏了一批极好的当地地图。
note: 形容词；不是 exceptional 的唯一同义词

example: Everyone except the guide had already crossed the bridge.
example_translation: 除了向导，其他人都已经过了桥。
note: 本例为介词，排除 guide

example: Her exceptional memory helped the team find the way back.
example_translation: 她非凡的记忆力帮助团队找到了归途。
note: 本例为能力超常；不是例外的常规情况

example: The students will exchange letters with a class in another city.
example_translation: 学生们将与另一个城市的一个班级交换书信。
note: exchange sth with sb

example: The children were excited about the journey to the lake.
example_translation: 孩子们对去湖边的旅程感到兴奋。
note: 描述感受；excited about

example: The guide told us an exciting story about the old tower.
example_translation: 向导给我们讲了一个关于旧塔的精彩故事。
note: 描述事物引起的感受；与 excited 区分

example: Please excuse the noise while the workers repair the roof.
example_translation: 工人们修理屋顶时，请原谅这些噪声。
note: 动词末尾 /z/；不是借口名词的 /s/

example: Regular exercise is part of her daily routine.
example_translation: 经常锻炼是她日常生活的一部分。
note: 本例不可数；不是练习题的可数义

example: Long climbs can exhaust even experienced walkers.
example_translation: 长时间攀登甚至会让经验丰富的步行者筋疲力尽。
note: exhaust sb；本例不是用尽物品义

example: The exhibition displays paintings inspired by journeys across the sea.
example_translation: 这场展览展示了以跨海旅程为灵感的画作。
note: 可数的一次展览

example: Some of the paths on the old map no longer exist.
example_translation: 旧地图上的一些小路已经不复存在。
note: 不及物；不使用被动形式

example: A small sign pointed towards the nearest exit.
example_translation: 一块小标牌指向最近的出口。
note: 本例为名词；不是退出动词

example: The library plans to expand its collection of books for young readers.
example_translation: 图书馆计划扩大面向年轻读者的图书收藏。
note: expand sth；本例为及物

example: The expansion of the station made room for more passengers.
example_translation: 车站的扩建为更多乘客提供了空间。
note: the expansion of sth

example: We expect to reach the village before sunset.
example_translation: 我们预计在日落前到达村庄。
note: expect to do sth

example: Her expectation was that the repairs would take a week.
example_translation: 她原本预期维修需要一周。
note: expectation that...；本例单数

example: Travel is the largest expense in the team's budget.
example_translation: 差旅是团队预算中最大的一项开支。
note: 本例为一项费用；总开支也常用 expenses

example: The guide chose a simple meal instead of an expensive one.
example_translation: 向导选择了一顿简单的饭，而不是一顿昂贵的饭。
note: 形容词；与名词 expense 区分

example: Her experience of mountain travel helped us prepare for the weather.
example_translation: 她的山地旅行经验帮助我们做好了应对天气的准备。
note: 本例为不可数经验；不是一次经历

example: The students designed an experiment to compare two kinds of paper.
example_translation: 学生们设计了一个实验，比较两种纸张。
note: 可数的一次实验

example: An expert in local history helped us understand the old letter.
example_translation: 一位当地历史专家帮助我们理解了这封旧信。
note: an expert in sth；本例为名词

example: Could you explain why this path is missing from the new map?
example_translation: 你能解释为什么这条小路没有出现在新地图上吗？
note: explain why...；向某人解释用 explain sth to sb

example: The engineer warned that the damaged tank might explode.
example_translation: 工程师警告说，受损的储罐可能会爆炸。
note: 不及物；本例不是情绪爆发

example: We hope to explore the valley beyond the old bridge.
example_translation: 我们希望探索旧桥那边的山谷。
note: explore a place；直接接地点

example: The company plans to export its tools to several other countries.
example_translation: 公司计划把工具出口到其他几个国家。
note: 动词后音节重读；不是出口名词

example: Do not expose the old map to direct sunlight.
example_translation: 不要让这张旧地图受到阳光直射。
note: expose sth to sth；本例不是揭露秘密义

example: Long exposure to sunlight faded the ink on the letter.
example_translation: 长时间日晒让信上的墨迹褪色。
note: exposure to sth；不可数

example: She used a short letter to express her thanks to the guide.
example_translation: 她用一封简短的信向向导表达了感谢。
note: express sth；不是快递或特快的名词/形容词

example: The town plans to extend the walking path as far as the lake.
example_translation: 小镇计划把步行小径延伸到湖边。
note: extend sth；本例为及物

example: The school added an extension to the library for group study.
example_translation: 学校扩建了图书馆，供小组学习使用。
note: 本例为建筑扩建部分；不是电话分机
